name: tco-m3-d0-d1prep01
argv:
import sys,time,unittest,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import run_profiled_d0 as common
import profiled_d1_math as math
runtime=common.runtime_identity()
names=sorted(str(p).replace('\\','/') for p in Path('scripts').glob('*profiled_d1*.py'))
before={name:common.sha(common.ROOT/name,text=True) for name in names}
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('scripts',pattern='test_profiled_d1_*.py')
start=time.monotonic()
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
after={name:common.sha(common.ROOT/name,text=True) for name in names}
report=dict(schema='profiled_d1_helper_preparation_v1',pass_all=result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped and before==after,tests_run=result.testsRun,skipped=result.skipped,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,source_sha256_lf=before,sources_unchanged=before==after,runtime=runtime,tolerances=math.tolerance_spec(),production_tensors_decoded=False,model_forward_calls=0,optimizer_updates=0,rental_usd=0,execution_ready=False,scope='Generated-data math, sensor-bridge, capture-order and artifact-boundary fixtures; not actual D1 model acceptance')
common.write_new(common.ROOT/'results/lora_profiled_d1_v1/preparation01.json',report)
raise SystemExit(0 if report['pass_all'] else 1)
